Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.pool

Interface ObjectPool<T>

All Known Implementing Classes:
NumaLocalObjectPool, ThreadLocalObjectPool
public interface ObjectPool<T>
High-performance object pool interface for HFT applications. Designed for minimal allocation and maximum throughput.

    • acquire

      T acquire()
      Acquire an object from the pool. Must be paired with a corresponding release() call.
      Returns:
